name: kxgovtshutdown
title: Will the US federal government be shut down on Dec 12, 2026?
settlement: If the United States federal government is at least partially shut down due to a lapse of appropriations at 10:00 AM ET on Dec 12, 2026, the market resolves Yes. A shutdown means orderly suspension of non-excepted agency work, typically with furloughs, when funding is unavailable.
decideContext: You are estimating the probability (0-100%) that a federal government shutdown due to lapsed appropriations is in effect at 10:00 AM ET on Dec 12, 2026, based on OMB/OPM shutdown status guidance; resolves binary Yes/No on that single criterion.
